##!source.syntax=xwiki/2.1
{{velocity}}
{{html clean="false"}}
## Base configuration for all BlockNote editor instances created on this web page.
#set ($config = {
  'collaborationURL': $services.websocket.url('yjs')
})
## Which users the mentions suggest. Left out when the wiki module isn't available, which leaves the mentions
## suggesting the local users only.
#set ($userScope = $services.wiki.user.userScope)
#if ($userScope)
  #set ($discard = $config.put('userScope', "$userScope"))
#end
<script id="blocknote-config" type="application/json">$jsontool.serialize($config).replace('<', '\u003C')</script>
{{/html}}
{{/velocity}}
